what: Declarations for the loop-topology rebuild, written and committed BEFORE any toy or pipeline code was run. The commit that adds this file is the pre-run hash. A mismatch is reported, never tuned; a later change is a dated entry under 'amendments', never an edit.
source_of_numbers: REPORTED: a prior session whose code is lost. Each number below is the work order's, copied by hand into this file. None was recomputed before this commit.

tolerance.rule: |rebuilt - recorded| <= 2e-3 per number -> MATCH, else MISMATCH
tolerance.second_column: ROUNDING_ONLY is reported beside a MISMATCH when |rebuilt - recorded| <= half a unit of the recorded number's last digit. It is information, not a pass.
tolerance.approx: numbers the order marks with an approximate sign carry the same 2e-3 rule; nothing is widened

units: entropy and information in nats; rates per unit time; sigma = entropy production rate

readings.note: where the order does not fix a definition, the definition used is declared here, before the run. A mismatch that traces to one of these is a mismatch of the reading and is reported as such.

T1.energy: E = -sum_i J_i s_i s_(i+1), open chain, P ~ exp(-E/T)
T1.cut_k: mutual information between spins 0..k-1 and spins k..3
T1.D: KL divergence between the distribution of an observable under P and under Q; Q = product of single-spin marginals
T1.sign: observable sign of the sum, 0 kept as its own value
T1.ring: 3 states, forward rate 3.0, backward 0.5; sigma = sum of flux times log ratio
T1.observer: states 1 and 2 read as one symbol; the chain sampled every dt; KL between the distribution of length-w windows and of their reversals, exact from the hidden-Markov forward sum, reported as the raw KL per window

T2.cut: net quantity through the cut, then the cost formula applied to the net
T2.true: cost formula applied per branch, then summed
T2.joule: two branches of R = 2 carrying +3 and -3
T2.futile: one cycle with flux J and affinity A, J*A = 50, net flux through the cut 0
T2.controls: the same four systems with the return branch removed; ratio = cut / true

T3.states: (x, y) bits; cycle 00 -> 01 -> 11 -> 10 -> 00 at rate 1 + c, reverse at 1 - c
T3.obs: the chain sampled every tau; KL of length-w windows against their reversals, divided by (w - 1) * tau; 'obs x' reads x only, 'obs y' reads y only, 'obs both' reads the state
T3.obs_both: ratio to sigma, reported at each of the four c values

T4.TE: transfer entropy rate at history length 1 on the tau-sampled chain: I(y_(t+tau); x_t | y_t) / tau; default tau 0.1
T4.HE_flow: Horowitz-Esposito information flow: rate of change of I(x;y) due to x jumps
T4.schnakenberg: A = 4 ln((1+c)/(1-c)), J = c/2, sigma = J * A

T5.estimator: second-order semi-Markov estimator on the merged process: affinity term sum R(ijk) ln[p(k | i,j) / p(i | k,j)] plus waiting-time term sum R(ijk) KL[psi(t | i,j,k) || psi(t | k,j,i)], R = rate of triples per unit time. Computed from the generator, not from a simulated path.
T5.unconditional_error: the affinity term with joint triple probabilities p(ijk) / p(kji) in place of the conditional ones
T5.rates_NOT_RECORDED: the order gives no ring rates for T5. Declared here: uniform rings, forward 3.0, backward 0.5 (the T1 ring's rates).
T5.uneven_NOT_RECORDED: the order gives 'uneven, drive 8' and no rates. Declared guess, labelled a guess: forward rates [8, 1, 1, 1], backward [1, 1, 1, 1], merge {0, 2}. Its row is reported with status PARAMS_NOT_RECORDED whatever it reads.

T6.graph: fast ring 0->1->2->0 at 10, reverse 4; slow ring 0->3->4->0 at 0.4, reverse 0.1
T6.sigma_per_loop: chord flux of the loop times the loop affinity
T6.cut_fraction: the T5 estimator on the merged process, divided by total sigma
T6.cuts: collapse fast = merge {1,2}; collapse slow = merge {3,4}; across = merge {1,3}; hub = merge {0,1}; both = merge {1,2} and {3,4}
T6.time_cut: chain sampled every tau, no states merged: (1/tau) * sum pi_i P_ij ln(P_ij / P_ji), divided by sigma
T6.markov_heat: sigma of the Markov chain on the merged states with rates k_AB = sum_(a in A, b in B) pi_a w_ab / pi_A

numbers.what: observer of both, tau 0.1, window 4, ratio to sigma; recorded as approximate
TE x->y and y->x at c = 0.05, tau 0.1
TE x->y and y->x at c = 0.2, tau 0.1
TE x->y and y->x at c = 0.5, tau 0.1
TE x->y and y->x at c = 0.9, tau 0.1

pipeline.simulation: Gillespie jump trajectory, seed 20261124, total time 50000
pipeline.cycles: fundamental cycles of the recovered rate graph from a spanning tree; sigma per cycle = chord net flux * cycle affinity

gates.rate: each of the 12 recovered rates within 0.10 relative of the planted rate
gates.sigma_per_cycle: each recovered cycle sigma within 0.10 relative of the T6 value
gates.null: detailed-balance planted graph (fast ring 7 / 7, slow ring 0.25 / 0.25), same seed and length: recovered total sigma <= 0.01
gates.flag: under a cut, the pipeline is run on the merged trajectory as if it were Markov; a loop is FLAGGED when a recovered cycle carries sigma > 0.01 (the null gate)

pipeline.cuts: the five T6 state cuts, and the five T6 time cuts (trajectory sampled every tau, transition matrix from counts)
